description:
Read acquisition developments and source mentions, with coverage and qualifiers.

        Filter sources by filing date (start/end YYYY-MM-DD). Developments reference these mentions;
        order_date/date_basis distinguish occurred action dates from filing-date placement.
        Development IDs apply only within deal+build, not across rebuilds or for notification deduplication.
        Omit build for current results; explicit build requests historical results. Developments are
        null when unavailable or from older rules; mentions can still be read in historical snapshots.
        related_mentions separately list connected transactions, not deduplicated deals; connection_citations
        provide source evidence for the link. Both citation types support get_passage. Related lists/counts
        are null when unavailable or from older rules; [] means no matching readable related sources.
        total_related_mentions counts the whole build before filing-date filtering; related_grouping is not_provided.
        Repeated sources are not new actions; expected/conditional items are not completed actions.
name: get_timeline
